title: Routine
overview: Benedicte constantly tries to escape her monotonous life by daydreaming about a warmer, kinder world. On yet another predictable day at work, she is confronted by a client for making a bad sandwich. After being reprimanded by her boss, she remakes the sandwich while checking for the time left to go home, sleep, and dream about tying both her manager and the client to a tree as she roams freely. The next morning, she wakes up to her alarm ringing... realizing that she had overslept and was late for work this time.
